package.description: High precision terminal map viewer with braille rendering

en-US.description: High precision terminal map viewer with braille rendering
en-US.longDescription:
TerminalMap is a high precision, interactive map viewer and embeddable Rust SDK
that turns OpenStreetMap vector tiles into beautiful braille/ASCII art, right in
any terminal. Works offline at low zoom. No API keys required.
en-US.name: TerminalMap
